description: Salesforce is a cloud-based CRM platform providing customer relationship management, data management, analytics, and developer integration capabilities.
api_breadth: Comprehensive API coverage including REST resources, Bulk API 2.0, Apex REST web services, SOAP API, Connect REST API, and hosted MCP servers exposing Salesforce platform capabilities.
mcp_evidence: Salesforce provides standard hosted MCP servers. They are disabled by default, require administrator activation, and use External Client App configuration for standard client connections.
blocker: OAuth configuration, administrator activation, edition requirements and user permissions.

evidence.title: Standard Servers | Reference | Hosted MCP Servers
evidence.supports: Native hosted MCP servers and their available tools, administrator activation, per-user authentication, and Salesforce security enforcement.
evidence.excerpt: Standard servers are pre-configured by Salesforce, disabled by default, and can be enabled by an administrator. They enforce per-user authentication and Salesforce security permissions.

evidence.title: Authorization Through External Client Apps or Connected Apps and OAuth 2.0
evidence.supports: OAuth 2.0 authorization for REST API access through External Client Apps or Connected Apps.
evidence.excerpt: A client application must be authorized using an External Client App or Connected App and an OAuth 2.0 authorization flow.

evidence.title: OAuth and Connect REST API
evidence.supports: OAuth authentication requirements for Connect REST API.
evidence.excerpt: Connect REST API uses OAuth to securely identify an application before connecting to Salesforce.

evidence.title: Supported Editions and Required Permissions
evidence.supports: API availability by Salesforce edition and the API Enabled user permission.
evidence.excerpt: API access is enabled by default in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and Developer Edition orgs. Professional Edition can add API access as an add-on. Users require API Enabled permission.

evidence.title: Activate MCP Servers
evidence.supports: Administrator activation requirements for hosted MCP servers.
evidence.excerpt: MCP servers are disabled by default and must be enabled by an administrator before clients can connect.

evidence.title: Set Up Your Org
evidence.supports: External Client App configuration, OAuth scopes, PKCE, and administrator permissions for MCP setup.
evidence.excerpt: MCP client setup requires an External Client App, OAuth scopes, and appropriate security configuration.

evidence.title: Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers
evidence.supports: Hosted MCP capabilities and Flex Credits usage considerations.
evidence.excerpt: Hosted MCP servers support OAuth-based integration and are intended for customers with Flex Credits; usage may incur charges.

research_notes: Salesforce provides a free Developer Edition with API access. Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited editions also include API access by default, while Professional Edition requires an API add-on. Users need the API Enabled permission. Hosted MCP servers require administrator activation and External Client App OAuth configuration. Hosted MCP usage may require Flex Credits. The buildability assessment is Medium because access depends on edition, permissions, authentication setup, and administrator configuration. Refined using manually reviewed verification data. See verification_status for field-level verification.
